title: refactor(ci): unify lint, test, and release workflows; optimize cache parallelism
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: our repo has grown a number of slightly different GH Actions workflows for lint, test, and release that duplicate configuration, slow down CI due to repeated setup steps, and drift when we bump node/go/python versions. This PR consolidates the primary lint/test/release flows into three shared, parametric workflows, extracts common setup/caching into a reusable action, and standardizes Node.js to 20.x across JS/TS packages. Goals: (1) reduce runtime and maintenance overhead, (2) make cache keys deterministic across matrices, (3) reduce duplicated steps that cause flaky runner throttling, (4) enable a single release pipeline with clearer dry-run gating.
commits: chore(ci): introduce .github/workflows/ci-common.yml and reusable setup action
feat(ci): consolidate lint jobs into .github/workflows/lint.yml using workflow_call
refactor(ci): merge test matrices into .github/workflows/test.yml and unify node versions
feat(release): add release/auto-release.yml with dry-run and canary toggles
chore(ci): update package.json scripts for CI-friendly flags and cache keys
fix(ci): tighten cache key salt to include GH runner and arch
docs(ci): update CONTRIBUTING.md with new CI run commands
review_comments: Diego Morales: Request for change - can we avoid using runner labels directly in cache keys? This caused cache fragmentation in previous rollouts.
Ava Chen: Reply - updated scripts/ci/cache-keys.sh to include a single stable salt and added runner arch only for platform-specific artifacts (see commit 'fix(ci): tighten cache key salt').
Priya Nair: Comment - release workflow looks good but we should gate publish with a required manual approval for the first rollout to a new channel.
Ava Chen: Reply - added manual approval step to auto-release.yml and a dry-run toggle via workflow_dispatch inputs.
Ethan Park: Suggestion - add a smoke e2e job that runs against a small test model in staging to catch integration regressions before canary.
Ava Chen: Reply - added a low-cost smoke job to test.yml with a fast timeout and cost cap; marked it optional for PRs to avoid slowing unit test runs.
merge_outcome: squash and merge by Priya Nair
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows (lint/test/release), added reusable CI setup action, standardized Node.js to 20.x across JS packages, improved cache key determinism and reduced CI runtime. No user-facing changes.
